verdict.rationale: Make's Developer Hub has dedicated Custom Apps documentation that covers the components of a custom connector: Base, Connections, Webhooks, Modules and Remote Procedure Calls, plus an editor choice. A TypeScript SDK covers most Make API endpoints, and OAuth client flows are documented for integrating apps. Missing for 10: explicit evidence on private (unpublished) app sharing or deployment, any evidence of a CLI, in-depth detail beyond component listings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
